description: Scaffold (or bring up to date) a WordPress plugin or block theme repository on this catalog's PHP toolchain. `flavor: plugin` writes the main plugin file (full header — Plugin Name, Description, Version `x.y.z-dev`, Requires at least, Requires PHP, Author, License GPL-2.0-or-later, Text Domain, Domain Path — plus an `ABSPATH` guard and a `<PREFIX>_VERSION` constant), a namespaced PSR-4 `src/` loaded through Composer's autoloader (a composition root, a filter service with a documented custom hook, a settings page whose `admin-post.php` handler checks nonce and capability, a REST route with a `permission_callback`), `uninstall.php`, `languages/`, a WordPress.org `readme.txt`, and `.distignore`; with `blocks: yes` it also wires `@wordpress/scripts` and a first block. `flavor: theme` writes a block theme — `style.css` header, `theme.json` v3, `templates/index.html`, `parts/header.html`/`footer.html`, translatable `patterns/`, and a small `functions.php` that requires namespaced classes. Both get `composer.json` (PSR-4, `config.platform.php` pinned to the floor; scripts `test`, `test:coverage`, `test:integration`, `lint`, `lint:report`, `format`, `format:check`), `phpcs.xml.dist` (WordPress-Extra + WordPress-Docs + PHPCompatibilityWP with `testVersion`, `minimum_wp_version`, text domain and prefixes), `phpstan.neon.dist` (phpstan-wordpress, level 6), a Brain Monkey `unit` suite (`phpunit.xml.dist`) and a `WP_UnitTestCase` `integration` suite (`phpunit-integration.xml.dist`) run inside a dedicated `@wordpress/env` environment (`.wp-env.json` + `.wp-env.test.json`, `package.json` used only for wp-env/`@wordpress/scripts`), sample tests, Clover/JUnit under `build/logs/`, browser UI tests per the catalog's UI contract (`.ui-quality.yml`, `playwright.config.ts` extending `wp-scripts test-playwright` against the wp-env tests instance, `@axe-core/playwright`, the shared `tests/e2e/support/ui-screenshots.ts` helper, a test-only RTL mu-plugin, and a sample spec — the plugin's `ContentNotice` component or the theme's `Index` screen — captured into `.ui-screenshots/` across left-to-right/right-to-left × light/dark with an accessibility check), and `sonar-project.properties` when `sonar` is not `none`. Resolves every dependency, the PHP floor, and the WordPress floor/tested-up-to versions live (Packagist, npm, php.net, api.wordpress.org), installs, and verifies the scaffold with its own gates. Invoke as `/iru-setup-php-wordpress`, or with `args` (`key: value` lines) — `flavor` (`plugin`/`theme`, asked when missing), `name`, `slug`, `vendor`, `namespace`, `prefix`, `description`, `license`, `developer-name`, `developer-email`, `organization-url`, `php-version`, `wp-version`, `blocks`, `open-source`, `visibility`, `ci`, `distribution` (`none`/`internal`/`store`), `sonar` (+ `sonar-organization`/ `sonar-project-key`/`sonar-host-url`), `accessibility` (`enforce`/`report`/`off`/`none`), `mode` (`new`/`existing`), `on-existing` (`ask`/`keep`/`update`/`replace`) — as `iru-setup-php-repository` passes them. Announces whether it creates from scratch or updates; for every owned file that already exists it warns and asks Update / Keep as is / Replace. Use whenever a WordPress plugin or block theme repository needs its code skeleton, tests, and quality tooling bootstrapped from this house template.
